extraction: Agents (agents.hot): Local-first runtime for AI agents and network protocol. Daemon-first runtime allowing agents to run locally with transcripts kept on user's machine. Build own agent network, expose to private mesh or public network. Ingress, discovery, public agent page. Supports runtimes like claude and codex. Agent discovery by capability, runtime, owner. Orchestration of multiple agents through standard protocol. Founded 2026, unfunded.
